```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(boot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)


```

# Load data

```{r}
# Mitox patient demographics
demo.dat <- read_excel("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/Patient Logs/Demographics/Patient_demographics.xlsx") %>%
  select(-MRN, -Name) %>%
  arrange(`Patient Id`) %>%
  drop_na(`Patient Id`) %>%
  rename(`Patient ID` = `Patient Id`) %>%
  select(-Cohort)


#Patient PFS data
pfspts <- readxl::read_xlsx(file.path("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/Clinical info/OSU-19125_patient_progression_RECIST_KK_v4.xlsx"), 
                               sheet = "Progression dates") %>% rename(`Patient ID` = `Patient Id`)

# RECIST criteria-based response to treatment
recist <- read_excel("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/Clinical info/OSU-19125_patient_progression_RECIST_KK_v4.xlsx") %>%
  select(-MRN, -Name)


# irAE documentation 
iraetab <- read_excel("T:/Labs/spakowicz/mitox/Clinical info/Mitoxstudy_patient_symptoms_AM_2.xlsx") %>%
  select(-`Patient Name`, -MRN) %>%
  drop_na(`Patient Id`) %>%
  rename(`Patient ID` = `Patient Id`)

#microbiome samples doc

microsamp <- readRDS("../data/dates.rds") %>% select(`Patient Id`, Microbiome.date)


```

# Filter pts with samples only & Define RECIST criteria and join

```{r responders vs nonresponders}

recist_samps <- recist %>% mutate(samples = 
                                    ifelse(`Baseline Scan` == "No Samples", 
                                           "No", "Yes")) %>% 
                                     filter(samples == "Yes")

recist_pts <- 
  recist_samps %>%
  mutate(pts = ifelse(Category == "PR" | Category== "CR", 
                          "responder", "nonresponder")) %>%
                          select(`Patient ID`, `Patient Type`, Category, 
                                 pts) #%>% drop_na(`Patient ID`)
                          


# write.csv(resnoninfo, "../data/mitox_resnoncombine.csv", row.names = FALSE)




```

# Define 12-month PFS and join

```{r}
#pfs_pts <- 
  #pfspts %>% 
  #mutate(PFS = ifelse(`12-month PFS` == "Yes", 
                      #"12-month PFS", 
                      #"No"))# %>% 
  #select(`Patient Id,`12-month PFS` ) #%>% 
  #drop_na(`12-month PFS`)

responsepts <- left_join(recist_pts,pfspts, by = "Patient ID") %>% 
                    select(`Patient ID`, `Patient Type`, 
                           Category, pts, `12-month PFS`) %>% 
                           rename(Cohort = `Patient Type`) %>%
                           rename(Response = pts)
                           
#responsepts <- 
  #responsepts_mut %>% 
  #unite('Response', pts.x:pts.y, remove = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  #select(`Patient ID`, Category, Response)


```

# Categorize and join irAEs

```{r irae}
irae <- 
  iraetab %>% 
  select(`Patient ID`, Symptoms, `Attribution (Final)`, `CTCAE grade (final)`,
         Onset, `Symptom Treatment`) %>%
  filter(grepl("Yes",`Attribution (Final)`, ))  %>% 
  mutate(#`Patient Id` = Patient.ID, 
         irAE = ifelse( `Attribution (Final)` == "Yes", 
                        "Yes", 
                        "No"))



#write.csv(irae, "iraeyes.csv" ,row.names = FALSE)

irae_full <- 
  iraetab %>% 
  select(`Patient ID`, Symptoms, `Attribution (Final)`, `CTCAE grade (final)`, 
         Onset, `Symptom Treatment`) %>%
  mutate(#`Patient Id` = Patient.ID, 
         irAE = ifelse( `Attribution (Final)` == "Yes", 
                        "Yes", 
                        "No")) %>% unique()

# table(irae$Symptoms)

# g2 <- 
#   irae %>%
#   filter(`CTCAE grade (final)` > 1)
# 
# table(g2$Symptoms)
```

# Write out cleaned clinical data table 

```{r}
responseandirae <- irae_full %>% full_join(demo.dat) %>% drop_na(irAE)

clean_mitox_data <- responseandirae %>% 
                    full_join(responsepts, by = "Patient ID") %>%
                    #unite('Cohort', Cohort.x:Cohort.y, remove = TRUE, 
                    #na.rm = TRUE)
                    select(`Patient ID`,`MDSC #`, Sex, Age, Race, Ethnicity, 
                           Treatment, Cohort, Stage, Symptoms,
                           `CTCAE grade (final)`, irAE, Onset, 
                           `Symptom Treatment`, Response, Category,
                           `12-month PFS`)
  

  
  write.csv(clean_mitox_data, "clean_mitox_data.csv" ,row.names = FALSE )

```
